title: DCP Coherent Syndrome Uncomputation and Reversible Oracle Bridge
claims: Secret-independent unitaries preserve coherent trace distance sqrt(1-|<Psi(s)|Psi(s')>|^2), NOT an upper bound by branch-average trace distance.
D_coherent >= D_dephased >= D_discarded. The branch-average formula applies only after dephasing the syndrome.
Native CNOT collimation has secret-dependent branch-amplitude phases that must be retained.

For zero branch-amplitude phases and publicly known secret-independent target phase offsets, explicit controlled phase correction and Hadamard gates erase the syndrome deterministically. This is not generic DCP uncomputation.
